mission: Deliver the prerequisites for a per-commit main verdict and raise the interim verdict rate without regressing pull-request latency: forbid agent cancels of main runs, land a throughput layout for main push runs with a published merge-timestamp replay, and re-dispatch missing verdicts. The per-commit verdict itself arrives as the merge-group run under the gated merge-queue-activation candidate (verdict-placement, D28).

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

statusNote: P0 complete 2026-11-13. Slice 1 (HOST-01 a, #3111) landed 2026-11-10: AGENTS.md and the orchestrate skill forbid cancelling any refs/heads/main run, queued or running, and #3140 enforces it in yeet gh checks cancel-queued and the merge gate; the ban's start date anchors the before/after verdict reads (checkpoint cancel-ban-start-anchor). beep ci certainty (#3118) is on main and reports the main verdict rate (CiCertaintyMainStat, CiCertaintyMainRow), but not PR first-wave pickup p95, heavy-wait p95, hosted jobs per run or the main cancel actor, and no certainty-scorecard slice builds them (decision scorecard-field-census); the pre-ban read for 2026-11-03..10 was refused as api-partial (history/2026-11-13-pre-ban-main-verdict-rate.md). The re-run API documents no conclusion restriction for cancelled push runs; whether a re-run re-enters the shared main group is undocumented, so re-dispatch fires only when no main run is queued or pending (decision rerun-api-cancelled-push-runs). Two measured days of Check runs (research/2026-11-13-check-run-queue-day-measure.md, decision check-run-queue-measurements) observe a hosted peak of 60 and 70 jobs per full run. P1 (the replay, the throughput layout, re-dispatch) is held under the SPEC stop condition until the scorecard reports first-wave pickup and heavy wait. ci/main-verdict means the landed throughput layout, which merge-queue-activation (explorations/github-merge-queue) waits on; the merge-timestamp replay, published as input for that candidate's owner (D28); and the interim main verdict rate after the layout and re-dispatch; per-SHA verdicts are that candidate's, not this goal's (D28).
